title: Replace a security operative licence
summary: Learn how to replace a lost, stolen, damaged, or illegible security operative licence.
intro:
If your licence is lost or stolen, you have 7 days to file a report and obtain an Event number:

If your licence is destroyed, damaged or illegible, you must first call the Security Licensing & Enforcement Directorate (SLED) on 1300 362 001.

### Update your contact details

If your contact details have changed you can update your details when you replace your licence online.
what_you_need: To check your security operative licence number and details, visit Verify NSW.

how_to_steps.text: Log in, or create your MyServiceNSW Account.
Follow the prompts to replace your security operative licence.
complete the application form Amend, vary or replace an existing Class 1 and/or Class 2 licence – PDF
send the form by post to the address on the form.
